notModelled: Selection. `::selection` and `user-select` have no Figma equivalent, so whether a role is selectable lives only in the .text-role-* classes; the browser tests are what check it.

The ambient-variant hue derivation. `label`, `caption` and `note` take their chroma and hue from the variant in context at their own lightness (`--text-role-l`), and this set has no Variant axis to express that — every specimen here is the default variant. The browser tests in text.browser.tsx are what check it.
